revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Arguments put forward by Cisca seem clear enough.

Vote - AcceptText - l.1: looking at the original, I agree that the number of strokes, and their ductus, at the end of κώμης is more or less the same in l.1 and l.3, although more outspoken in l.3. both words should thus be transcribed the same way. it is more a matter of opinion if the ης was felt by the writer to be written fully (then in Verschleifung), or as η ending in abbreviation mark η(ς), or as an abbreviation mark instead of ης. soI agree with l.1 (κώμ(ης)) l. 6, I agree; other omikrons in l.1-3 were written as a cirkle ending to he upper left. do not forget underdot, so change <:Φίβις (συμ̣φ(ωνεῖ))|PN L. Berkes (autopsy)|ed|Φίβιος (<σ>υμ̣φ(ωνεῖ)):> add following corrections: l.3 (μ(όνα)) with dots under όνα (if possible); space in l.5 Πεε[ῦς(?)]([ἀ]παιτ̣η(τὴς)) > Πεε[ῦς(?)] ([ἀ]παιτ̣η(τὴς)) and from BL: l. 2 (συνηθεί(ας)) > <:(|συνημ|)=BL 10.116|ed|(συνηθεί(ας)):> ; l.5 Ἰ(¨)ωσῆπις > <:<:᾽Ι(¨)ωάννης|alt|᾽Ι(¨)ωάννις:>=BL 10.116|ed|Ἰ(¨)ωσῆπις:>

Vote - DEFER - I defer to someone with a better eye for this period. Lin1 I can see (κώμ(ης)); if we accept then encode: <:(κώμ(ης))|PN L. Berkes (autopsy)|ed|κώμης:>; about lin6 I am less confident; I'd have thought the ed's omicron, which is here proposed to be read as sigma, secure. But I may well be wrong. Need another's eyes. In any case, if accepted, encode <:Φίβις (συμφ(ωνεῖ))|PN L. Berkes (autopsy)|ed|Φίβιος (<σ>υμ̣φ(ωνεῖ)):>
I saw the original in Leiden. I propose two minor corrections: l.1: κώμης --> (κώμ(ης)) l. 6. Φίβιος (<σ>υμ̣φ(ωνεῖ)) ---> Φίβις (συμ̣φ(ωνεῖ)).
